name: General Translation
settings.subtitle: Choose what to translate and how translations reach your readers.
settings.projectHint: Use the project that matches your source locale. Save settings before testing the connection.
settings.keyHelp: Set GT_API_KEY on the Strapi server, then restart it. The key stays on the server and cannot be edited here.
settings.mappingHint: Map each Strapi locale to a supported GT locale. Strapi locale codes stay unchanged.
settings.fieldsHint: Localized text is selected by default. Numbers, relations and shared media files are kept. Nested fields use their parent selection and context.
settings.noTypes: No localized content types are available. Enable internationalization on a content type to configure its fields.
settings.contextHint: Optional instructions to help GT understand this field.
settings.media: Translate media alt text and captions for {model}
settings.mediaHint: Localized metadata is stored per document and locale. Edit it in the translation panel. The Media Library still edits shared metadata. Published REST reads include valid localized metadata.
settings.deliveryHint: Translations remain drafts when Draft and Publish is enabled, unless automatic publishing is selected. Content without Draft and Publish is visible immediately. Content and locale permissions still apply.
settings.autoHint: Automatic translation is off by default. It uses the configured targets and requires an authorized actor.
translation.title: Translate content
translation.source: Translates saved {locale} content into the selected locales.
translation.count: {count, plural, one {# document selected} other {# documents selected}}
translation.consent: I reviewed the target content and accept replacing human edits
translation.noTargets: No target locales are configured. Ask an administrator to choose target locales in General Translation settings.
translation.unsaved: Save this document before translating it. Unsaved changes are not sent to GT.
translation.notConfigured: Ask an administrator to configure General Translation before translating.
translation.draft: New translations will be saved as drafts for review.
translation.published: Translations will be published automatically when your permissions allow it.
translation.immediate: This content type does not use Draft and Publish. Saved translations are visible immediately.
translation.create: Missing target locales can be created when your permissions allow it.
translation.keepMissing: Create missing target locales in Content Manager before translating.
translation.cost: Translation uses your organization's GT account. Force retranslation may incur new charges.
jobs.title: Job history
jobs.subtitle: Review translation progress, resulting locales and actionable failures.
jobs.empty: No translation jobs yet. Translate a saved document to create the first job.
media.title: Localized media metadata
media.help: These changes belong only to this document and locale. The Media Library changes shared source metadata.
media.draft: Edits are saved to the locale's draft and appear after publishing it.
media.published: Published metadata is read only. Switch to the draft tab to edit it.
media.immediate: This content type does not use Draft and Publish. Metadata edits are visible immediately.
media.empty: No eligible media metadata is available. Enable media metadata in settings and save media on this locale.
media.label: Localized {property}: {path}
media.nullHint: An empty string is kept as an intentional empty value. Reset restores shared source metadata.
media.caption: caption
